text: Why do the QK-transpose and AV products in transformer attention break the 'weight-stationary' assumption most photonic accelerators rely on?
choices: Because the softmax cannot be computed in optics at all
Because the projections Q = X*W_Q are dynamic while the attention products are static

Because QK-transpose and AV multiply activations by activations (both operands computed at runtime), so a weight-stationary mesh would have to reload its matrix every token, hitting the microsecond weight-update wall
explanation: The projections are weight-stationary (static W), but QK-transpose and AV have both operands generated at runtime, so a mesh holding static weights would need to reload at the token rate, far faster than the microsecond update speed. Softmax does stay electronic but that is not the weight-stationary issue (option 0), option 1 reverses which stage is dynamic, and precision is not the barrier (option 2).
